size_rationale: Medium because the symptom shows where tokens are verified (passport strategy, verifyToken), but the cause sits one step away in the shared generateToken helper used for every token type.
prompt: Expired tokens are still accepted: an access token past its expiry time still authenticates requests, and an expired refresh token can still be exchanged at POST /v1/auth/refresh-tokens.

root_cause.detail: generateToken sets the JWT exp claim to expires.valueOf() (milliseconds) instead of expires.unix() (seconds), so every token's expiry is tens of thousands of years out and jwt.verify never rejects it as expired.

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/auth.test.js > Auth routes > POST /v1/auth/refresh-tokens > should return 401 error if refresh token is expired
tests/integration/auth.test.js > Auth middleware > should call next with unauthorized error if access token is expired
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/auth.test.js -t 'should return 401 error if refresh token is expired|should call next with unauthorized error if access token is expired'
